title: Nashville HYVE Music City
description:
This contemporary 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom designer suite is located in the heart of Nashville. it’s walking distance to the world famous Broadway and Music Row where many musicians cut records giving Nashville its nickname Music City. This is the perfect location for a quick weekend getaway, business trips, wedding parties or looking for a home to relax after visiting the music venues, museums, restaurants, and speakeasies. Boredom is not an option!

The space
This is a 2 bedroom property with one bed in each., One King size and one queen size.  There is a sofa/sleeper bed that’s sleeps 2. The apartment can comfortably accommodate 6 people. 

The apartment has a fully fitted kitchen and everything needed to cook a beautiful meal for you and your friends.

A gym is available for your use and it’s actually a gym with decent equipment.

A pool is available for your leisure. Please use ONLY PLASTIC cups which are provided for free. They are in the kitchen cabinet.

Guest access
Keypad code will be provided a day before you arrive. The code will allow access to all areas of the building.
